林国强看向她，表情严肃。

“美丽，我不是不想让你嫁得好，我是怕你嫁过去受罪。”

“你怎么知道我会受罪？”

林美丽的眼圈红了，“你又不是王超，你怎么知道他是什么人？

你凭什么在外面听了几句闲话，就来毁我的亲事？”

“美丽……”

“二哥，我知道你对我好，”林美丽的眼泪掉了下来，“但你也不能……不能这样啊。

王超家条件好，他爹是主任，他妈是街道办事处的，家里有五间大瓦房。

我嫁过去，以后就是镇上的人了，吃商品粮，不用再在地里刨食，这有什么不好的？”

林国强看着她，忽然觉得很无力。

上一世，林美丽也是这么说的。

“吃商品粮”“镇上的人”“不用种地”。

她嫁过去的时候，满心欢喜，觉得自己跳出了农门。

后来被打得头破血流跑回娘家的时候，她说的却是……

“二哥，我当初要是听你的就好了。”

但这话，要等到大半年之后才会说。

现在，她说的是“你凭什么毁我的亲事？”

“美丽，”林国强深吸了一口气，尽量让自己的语气平和，“我不拦你，我就问你一件事，你能不能先别急着答应，去镇上打听打听王超这个人？

问问农机厂的老工人，问问供销社的人，问问左邻右舍。

如果打听到的结果跟我说的不一样，你想嫁就嫁。”

林美丽犹豫了。

李红霞却不给她犹豫的机会：“打听什么打听？！人家王主任亲自上门提亲，礼数周全，诚意十足。

你倒好，让你妹妹去打听人家？传出去像什么话？！人家还以为咱们林家不识抬举！”

“妈，打听一下怎么了？”

林美玲忍不住开口了，“美丽嫁人是大事，多了解了解男方的情况不是应该的吗？二哥说的也有道理……”

“你也闭嘴！”李红霞瞪了她一眼，“你一个嫁出去的闺女，少在这儿掺和娘家的事！”

林美玲的脸涨红了，嘴唇哆嗦了几下，被陈建国拉住了。

“妈，”林美丽终于开口了，声音不大，但很坚定，“我愿意。”

堂屋里安静了。

“我愿意嫁给王超。”

林美丽抬起头，眼眶红红的，但嘴角微微翘着，“二哥，我知道你是为我好。

但这是我的事，我自己做主。”

林国强看着她，沉默了很久。

他想起上一世，林美丽被打得头破血流跑回娘家的样子。

Lin Guoqiang looked at her with a serious expression.

"Meimei, it's not that I don't want you to marry well, I'm afraid that you'll suffer the consequences if you get married."

"How do you know I'm going to suffer?"

Lin Meili's eyes were red, "You are not Wang Chao, how do you know who he is?

Why did you come to ruin my marriage after hearing a few gossips outside?"

"Beautiful..."

"Second brother, I know you are good to me," Lin Meili's tears fell, "but you can't...can't do this.

Wang Chao's family has good conditions. His father is the director and his mother works in the subdistrict office. There are five large tile-roofed houses in the family.

If I get married, I will be a resident of the town. I will eat commercial food and no longer have to dig in the fields. What's wrong with that?"

Lin Guoqiang looked at her and suddenly felt very powerless.

Lin Meili said the same thing in her last life.

"Eat commercial grain" "people in the town" "don't have to farm".

When she got married, she was so happy that she felt like she had jumped out of the farm gate.

Later, when she ran back to her parents' home with a bloody head, what she said was...

"Second brother, I wish I had listened to you."

But I won’t say this until more than half a year later.

Now, what she is saying is "Why do you ruin my marriage?"

"Beautiful," Lin Guoqiang took a deep breath and tried to keep his tone as calm as possible, "I won't stop you, but I'm just going to ask you something. Can you stop rushing to agree and go to the town to find out about Wang Chao?

Ask the old workers at the agricultural machinery factory, the people in the supply and marketing cooperatives, and the neighbors.

If the result of the inquiry is different from what I told you, you can marry if you want."

Lin Meili hesitated.

Li Hongxia didn't give her a chance to hesitate: "What are you asking about?! Director Wang came to propose marriage in person, with all the courtesy and sincerity.

How about you ask your sister to inquire about others?What does it sound like?!People still think that our Lin family doesn’t know how to praise!"

"Mom, may I ask what's wrong?"

Lin Meiling couldn't help but speak, "Marrying a beautiful woman is a big deal. Isn't it necessary to know more about the man's situation? What the second brother said makes sense..."

"Shut up!" Li Hongxia glared at her, "You are a married girl, so stop interfering in your mother's family's affairs here!"

Lin Meiling's face turned red, her lips trembled a few times, and she was pulled back by Chen Jianguo.

"Mom," Lin Meili finally spoke, her voice not loud but firm, "I do."

The hall was quiet.

"I am willing to marry Wang Chao."

Lin Meili raised her head, her eyes were red, but the corners of her mouth were slightly raised, "Second brother, I know you are doing it for my own good.

But this is my business, I make the decision myself."

Lin Guoqiang looked at her and was silent for a long time.

He remembered how in the last life, Lin Meili was beaten with a bloody head and ran back to her parents' home.
